name: AK28B - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), 4-Button Control, Big-Digit Display
highlights: Direct Controls, Distance Reading — Four dedicated front keys under a screen built around one dominant figure. Set it up in seconds; read it from the far wall.
Colour Blocks Along the Top — Values grouped into labelled colour blocks above the main reading, so a scan tells you which category is out of range before you read any digits.
Same Sensing as AK28A — Eight parameters, laser particulate split, AQI scale — only the screen differs.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour charge, 230 g, moulded wedge stand.
Two Faces on One Body — AK28A and AK28B share tooling, packaging and 32-per-carton spec — two catalogue entries, one production line.
